decision: PostgresTimerStore (raw pg, parameterised SQL, injected Clock) за интерфейсом enqueue/fetchAndFire/cancel/done. Таблица choros.app_timer (migration 011): tenant_id ведущий PK, due_at bigint, state text CHECK, kind/payload/fired_at/cancel_reason. FORCE RLS + fail-closed политика на GUC choros.tenant_id. Partial-index (tenant_id, due_at) WHERE state='pending'. SECURITY DEFINER-функция next_due_buckets() (migration 012) возвращает только агрегат (tenant_id, timer_count) без данных строк. fetchAndFire: BEGIN; SET LOCAL; CTE SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT N; UPDATE state='firing'; COMMIT. Health расширяется timer.timerLagMs (null=нет просрочки, degraded при ошибке). Ops ops/catalog/timer_stats.ts (T0, идемпотентный SELECT). known_tenant_tables.txt += app_timer.

rejected_alternatives.why_not: Spec Out of Scope §5 п.2; добавляет stateful push-соединения, усложняет отказоустойчивость без пользы на silo-нагрузке.
Для обнаружения просроченных тенантов choros_app нужен full-scan без GUC — нарушает RLS-изоляцию. SECURITY DEFINER-агрегат минимально и безопасно расширяет поверхность.
Дублирует субстрат. Stack ADR §1 п.3 явно называет due_at + partial index как механизм прикладных таймеров на Postgres.
Spec Out of Scope §5; stack ADR — не до S2.

rejected_alternatives.option: Один общий store-метод вместо fetchAndFire + next_due_buckets
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Фаза-1 работает без GUC (SECURITY DEFINER), фаза-2 требует GUC. Смешение скрывало бы разницу контекстов и нарушало бы security-boundary.
Spec Out of Scope §5. Усложняет семантику без текущей потребности.

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.type: uuid NOT NULL — ведущий PK (T-0013 §3.1); PK(tenant_id,id)

fields.name: id
fields.type: uuid NOT NULL — уникальный идентификатор таймера

fields.name: due_at
fields.type: bigint NOT NULL — unix epoch ms; момент срабатывания

fields.name: kind
fields.type: text NOT NULL — тип таймера (inbox_sla, lease_renew, retry, …); непрозрачен для dispatcher

fields.name: payload
fields.type: jsonb NOT NULL — прикладная нагрузка; непрозрачна для dispatcher

fields.name: created_at
fields.type: bigint NOT NULL — unix epoch ms (Clock.now() при enqueue)

fields.name: fired_at
fields.type: bigint NULL — установлен dispatcher при переходе → firing

fields.name: input
fields.type: p_due_before bigint — unix epoch ms cutoff

fields.name: returns
fields.type: TABLE(tenant_id uuid, timer_count bigint) — только агрегат, без полей строк

fields.name: security
fields.type: SECURITY DEFINER; owner=choros_migrator; EXECUTE granted to choros_app; no DDL for choros_app

fields.name: enqueue
fields.type: (tenantId: string, kind: string, payload: Record<string,unknown>, dueAt: number) => Promise<AppTimer>

fields.name: fetchAndFire
fields.type: (tenantId: string, dueBeforeMs: number, limit: number) => Promise<AppTimer[]>

fields.name: cancel
fields.type: (tenantId: string, timerId: string, reason?: string) => Promise<boolean>

fields.name: getTimerHealth
fields.type: () => Promise<{ timerLagMs: number | null }> — throws on Postgres error

fields.name: timer.timerLagMs
fields.type: number | null — NEW T-0116; null=нет просрочки; degraded+null при ошибке

fields.name: timerLagMs
fields.type: number | null — MAX(now - due_at) WHERE state='pending' AND due_at < now

fields.name: error_variant
fields.type: { ok: false, error: string } при ошибке соединения

contracts: fetchAndFire SQL: BEGIN; SET LOCAL choros.tenant_id=$1; WITH candidates AS (SELECT id FROM choros.app_timer WHERE state='pending' AND due_at<$2 ORDER BY due_at ASC LIMIT $3 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE choros.app_timer t SET state='firing', fired_at=$4 FROM candidates WHERE t.id=candidates.id RETURNING t.*; COMMIT
next_due_buckets SQL (SECURITY DEFINER): SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS timer_count FROM choros.app_timer WHERE state='pending' AND due_at<$1 GROUP BY tenant_id

getTimerHealth SQL (migrator connection, no GUC): SELECT MIN(due_at) AS oldest_overdue_at FROM choros.app_timer WHERE state='pending' AND due_at<=$1; timerLagMs = oldest_overdue_at IS NOT NULL ? ($1 - oldest_overdue_at) : null

enqueue SQL: INSERT INTO choros.app_timer (tenant_id, id, due_at, state, kind, payload, created_at) VALUES (current_setting('choros.tenant_id',false)::uuid, $1, $2, 'pending', $3, $4::jsonb, $5) RETURNING *
cancel SQL: UPDATE choros.app_timer SET state='cancelled', cancel_reason=$3 WHERE id=$2 AND state='pending'; returns rowCount>0
done SQL: UPDATE choros.app_timer SET state='done' WHERE id=$2 AND state='firing'; returns rowCount>0

timer_stats SQL (migrator, no RLS): SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state='pending') AS pending_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state='firing') AS firing_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state='done') AS done_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state='cancelled') AS cancelled_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state='pending' AND due_at<$1) AS overdue_count, MAX($1-due_at) FILTER (WHERE state='pending' AND due_at<$1) AS timer_lag_ms FROM choros.app_timer
known_tenant_tables.txt: добавить строку 'app_timer' — cross-tenant тест T-0115 подхватывает таблицу без изменений самого теста
Migration 011_app_timer.sql: CREATE TABLE + ENABLE/FORCE RLS + policy + GRANT + CREATE INDEX idx_app_timer_pending ON choros.app_timer(tenant_id,due_at) WHERE state='pending'

Migration 012_next_due_buckets.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION choros.next_due_buckets(bigint) RETURNS TABLE(tenant_id uuid, timer_count bigint) SECURITY DEFINER + REVOKE ALL FROM PUBLIC + GRANT EXECUTE TO choros_app
GET /health response schema extension: {status, queue:{depth,oldestAvailableLagMs}, timer:{timerLagMs}} — timer block added backward-compatible
